title: Senior Full-Stack Developer to Build/Rebuild Our Custom Website & Ecommerce Platform
description:

We need an experienced developer to build a custom web application / ecommerce platform for us — or rebuild and migrate the one we already have. title: Claude expert to build a working copy of native.no
description:
I'm hiring one person to build an MVP that replicates native.no. Go study that site before applying, it's the exact spec: a business owner enters their website URL, the product analyzes their business, generates a month of social posts (text + images) in their brand voice, and publishes approved posts to social channels after approval.

To be clear: this is a 1:1 functional copy. The functionality and features should be exactly what native.no offers, no more, no less. Organic social content only, no paid ads features.

MVP SCOPE (native.no's core loop)
- Landing page with signup, in our own brand and design
- URL in, brand and business analysis out
- Generation pipeline producing 30+ posts with images
- Simple dashboard: review, edit in plain language, approve
- Publishing to Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn via an aggregator API (Ayrshare or similar)
- Basic auth and billing (Stripe)

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

An expert with Claude or similar AI tools. You don't need a traditional dev background, you need to ship working products with Claude Code or comparable tooling and know the Claude API inside out. Stack is your call, I care about output.

The critical skill: taste in LLM outputs. Anyone can wire up an API call that produces content. I need someone who can look at 50 generated posts, see why they feel generic, and fix it through better prompting, examples and feedback loops. The product lives or dies on whether a business owner is proud to publish these posts. If your instinct is "the API returned text, ship it," this isn't for you.

STRUCTURE

Fixed price for the MVP. Ongoing work after that if it's good.

TO APPLY

1. Show me something that you have built.
2. Tell me one thing native.no does that will be hardest to replicate well, and why.
3. Offer your price and how long you'll need.

No generic cover letters.

title: WordPress Ecommerce Website Developer with Security & AI Automation Tasks
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress eCommerce Developer to build a modern, responsive, and user-friendly online store. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in WordPress, WooCommerce, custom theme development, and plugin integration. You will be responsible for creating a secure, high-performing eCommerce website that delivers an excellent shopping experience across all devices. 

Key Responsibilities 
* Design, develop, and launch a fully functional WordPress eCommerce website. 
* Install, configure, and customize WooCommerce. 
* Develop or customize WordPress themes to match brand requirements. 
* Integrate payment gateways, shipping methods, and tax settings. 
* Set up product categories, product pages, and inventory management. 
* Optimize website performance, speed, and SEO. 
* Ensure the website is mobile-friendly and responsive. 
* Implement security best practices and regular backups. 
* Integrate third-party plugins and APIs as needed. 
* Test the website across different browsers and devices. 
* Troubleshoot bugs, fix issues, and provide post-launch support. 
* AI customer support automation
* Document website setup and provide basic training if required.

Required Skills & Qualifications 
* Proven experience developing WordPress websites. 
* Strong knowledge of WooCommerce. 
* Proficiency in PHP, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and MySQL. 
* Experience with Elementor, Gutenberg, or other page builders. 
* Knowledge of responsive web design principles. 
* Familiarity with website optimization and SEO best practices. 
* Experience integrating payment gateways such as Stripe, PayPal, or local payment solutions. 
* Understanding of website security and performance optimization. 
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues efficiently. 
* Strong communication, project management and AI automation skills.

Preferred Qualifications 
* Experience with custom plugin development. 
* Knowledge of REST APIs and third-party integrations. 
* Experience with multilingual or multi-currency eCommerce websites. 
* Familiarity with Git/version control and AI automation. 
* Experience with hosting platforms and website migrations.

Deliverables 
* Fully functional WordPress eCommerce website. 
* Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. 
* Secure payment gateway integration. 
* Product management system. 
* SEO-friendly website structure. 
* Contact forms and customer account functionality.
* Order management and email notifications. 
* Website documentation, AI automation and deployment.

Success Criteria 
* Fast-loading and secure website. 
* Smooth checkout process. 
* Responsive and user-friendly design.
* Clean, maintainable code. 
* Successful deployment with minimal post-launch issues.
